en: Colorized historic view of a cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑story townhouses. In the center-left stands an ornate baroque town hall building with a clock and a tall tower topped by an onion-shaped spire. A statue on a pedestal stands before the town hall, and decorative street lamps line the square. Several people and a horse-drawn carriage are visible. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed German captions identify the town and the market with the town hall, and business signs are visible on the façades.
